# runpod_pods (Data Source)

All pods owned by the authenticated account. Pods that belong to a cluster are left out unless include_cluster_pods is set.

**If you are an AI agent:** set up through https://agents.runpod.io first, then follow
[Using the provider from an AI agent](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/runpod/runpod/latest/docs/guides/agent-setup) before you plan or apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "runpod_pods" "all" {}

output "running_pod_ids" {
  description = "Pods currently reported as running."
  value       = [for p in data.runpod_pods.all.pods : p.id if p.status == "RUNNING"]
}
```

Complete, runnable configurations that use this data source live in the
[use-case modules](https://github.com/runpod/terraform-provider-runpod/tree/main/v2/modules);
the Guides section documents each one.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `include_cluster_pods` (Boolean) Include pods that belong to a cluster. Defaults to false; runpod_cluster_pods lists one cluster's members on their own.

### Read-Only

- `pods` (Attributes List) One entry per pod. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pods))

<a id="nestedatt--pods"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pods`

Read-Only:

- `cloud` (String) Cloud tier: SECURE or COMMUNITY.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp in RFC 3339 format.
- `data_center_id` (String) Data center the pod runs in.
- `disk` (Number) Container disk in GB (ephemeral).
- `gpu_count` (Number) Number of GPUs attached to the pod.
- `gpu_type_id` (String) GPU type identifier; null for a pod with no GPU.
- `id` (String) Pod identifier.
- `image` (String) Docker image reference.
- `name` (String) Pod display name.
- `status` (String) Pod lifecycle status, e.g. RUNNING, EXITED, PROVISIONING.
